name: comp-588
blurb: Icon navbar with centered logo and user avatar stack.
description: Header with icon nav on left, centered logo, and right side showing user avatars (online/offline status) plus add-user button. Responsive.
use_when: Collaboration or messaging apps showing active team members in the header.
avoid_when: Sparse teams or text-first UX; avatar stacks work best with 3+ visible members.
a11y: Icons have aria-label. Avatar images have alt text. Add-user button labeled.
